title: Residents shouldn’t have to know the system to ask for help.
description: Weeks 1–3: illustrative resident persona, failure moment, problem statement and a verified synthetic language-check data point.
speakerNotes: Data source: reports/civic-readiness/initial-evaluation-results.json, metrics.languageParity = 5 passed / 7 total. These are synthetic developer-authored checks, not observed resident outcomes, production accuracy or a City usability study.

title: Everyday words in. A grounded next step out.
description: Weeks 4–6: annotated captures from the main app, meaningful structured extraction, plain-language staff explanation and Replit URL.
speakerNotes: Screenshots use a synthetic resident and real main-app UI. The user confirmed structured data extraction as the matching course Labs category. The model extracts issue, requested action, supporting quote and uncertainty. Curated routing checks—not the model alone—select supported service guidance. No official City case is filed.

title: A language gap briefly became an extra step.
description: Week 7: exact synthetic red-team input and wrong clarification, concrete extra-step harm, applied mitigation and retest limits.
speakerNotes: Source: initial-evaluation-results.json case renewal-de, language de, status clarify, clarifying_question Möchten Sie Ihren Führerschein erneuern oder ersetzen? Later evaluation-results.json languageParity = 7/7. Both reports are under reports/civic-readiness/. Retests on a development corpus are regression evidence, not independent validation. No resident harm was measured.

title: A prototype safeguard is not City privacy approval.
description: Week 7: unmet City privacy/retention governance approval and concrete conditions before a live resident pilot.
speakerNotes: These are proposed deployment conditions, not claims of existing City approval or an exhaustive legal compliance assessment. City privacy/security owners must approve data handling and AI-provider terms, named access owners, retention/deletion, incident response and evidence those controls work.

title: Residents are the primary user; staff are the review partner.
description: Primary and adjacent users, with the absence of documented session feedback stated explicitly.
